description: Free public tape of the latest large prediction-market trades (roughly $1k+ notional) across venues, newest first: side, outcome, USD value, price, market question, and the event it printed on. Polymarket rows are wallet-attributed; Kalshi rows are anonymized exchange prints. A large print is information, not a recommendation. No API key required.
name: pm_data_whales
title: Get latest prediction-market whale trades
